result: Exact input value QA 목록 보존 1919 is equal before OFF, after ON, and after step4→step3→step4. OFF shows one retained item and unmounts nine text/number fields.
limitations: One representative custom title on List at402px. Does not establish every field/type or each width.
Home retention relies on bounded historic QA report and images, not current execution or exact-value raw trace.
OFF fields are unmounted: retained title is established by re-ON input value, not hidden application state inspection.
Date/time inputs were minimal local navigation data; their strings are not timezone assertions.
Title/sport and changed promotion text were explicitly restored; local dates were not rechecked after cancelling. UI exit does not directly audit storage.
Query cache localStorage exists; no global-storage-absence claim.
Runtime commit not exposed. Deployment context is external evidence.
The nine fields are mounted DOM records, not nine simultaneously visible fields. Several are outside the viewport; screenshots cover only the titled input/preview and collapsed summaries.
The input label:null in active metadata does not erase the named field-level input.value evidence. This run is not an accessible-name or keyboard-route audit.
Dates are not rechecked after Cancel; actual list exit and removal of the wizard are observed, not storage erasure.
